nodes.label: Per-row argmin margin m(Z)
nodes.rationale: m(Z) = E(runner-up) - E(winner) over the admissible candidate set actually compared, in mHa, at each Z in 2..108.

nodes.label: Chain margin is not the per-row argmin margin
nodes.rationale: The 32.33 mHa already owned at Z=89 is a CHAIN margin; if the per-row argmin margin comes out identical that is a flag that the same column was re-read, not a new measurement.

nodes.label: VOID risk: no stored runner-up column
nodes.rationale: The chain may store only the winner; the prediction declares in advance that nothing would then be measured and the score is VOID rather than reinterpreted.
